name: Kuna's Delve
summary: Kuna's Delve is a mine in northern Reaper's March, south of Arenthia containing trolls. They are led by a massive armored troll known as Limbrender. Centipedes and torchbugs are found in numbers within. Reading Supplies for the Delve at Kuna's office in Rawl'kha will mark this location on your map.
